d: Platinum white eyebrows and a long, braided platinum white beard characterize this elderly, anthropomorphic goat. The eyes are narrow and squinted, set into a mature, wrinkled face with large, curving brown horns. A stout build is draped in a heavy, deep blue robe with gold trim and wide sleeves, complemented by a circular gold collar. The figure holds a gnarled brown wooden staff topped with a blue orb and light blue leaves. BODY COLOR: Brown and white LEGS: Plantigrade, with brown fur and small hooves.
